steady.note: scripts/perf/workloads/steady.dark, trace detail off, with `startup` taken off: the workload's own allocation, the median of three warm runs each. `publishedMode` is which publish mode the published number was taken in; the gate refuses a binary from the other one. Lower these whenever a change earns it (scripts/perf/gate --published --update). Method and history: docs/perf/history.md. Do not add historical comments to this line, basically never change this comment.

startup.note: scripts/perf/workloads/startup.dark, one line of output: process start, opening the store, loading packages. Budgeted on its own so a startup regression still fails, and taken off steady's number so it does not dilute the workload's.

cold.note: The first run of steady.dark on a store grown from nothing, with the GC settings the gate pins. Recorded by `scripts/perf/gate --published --update` with the steady number.

paired.note: CPU of fib 24, lists and ls, over the same on the reference release, median of paired rounds; see scripts/perf/_paired.py. The reference is the newest release on GitHub; this pin is only the fallback for when GitHub cannot be reached, so it never needs moving.

suite.note: Allocation per iteration of each workload in scripts/perf/workloads/suite/, as `scripts/perf/suite --release --iters <iters>` measures it: 0 iterations differenced against `iters`, so startup and parsing cancel. Recorded by `scripts/perf/gate --published --update` with the rest. recursion's tolerance is wider because it allocates almost nothing per iteration, so a run's few KB of noise is a bigger share of it (256 to 299 bytes over five runs).

ui.note: The interactive CLI at 120x40, from scripts/perf/workloads/ui/workbench.dark (see scripts/perf/_ui.py): VM instructions, which repeat exactly, and allocation, which sees the builtins where most of a keypress goes. firstFrame is process start to the workbench's first frame built and painted to a string; keypress is one Down or Up in Code at Darklang.Stdlib.List: the key handled, the next frame built and diffed. Recorded by `scripts/perf/gate --published --update` with the rest.
